technical_claims.claim: POST /snapshot with a UTF-8 plain-text DSL body (Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8) returns image bytes on success and a JSON {code,message,requestId} object on failure; 429/503 carry Retry-After
technical_claims.verified_by: two real 400 PARSE_ERROR bodies (tmp/run-20261011-01/A17/smoke/smoke-01.png.error.json, smoke-03.png.error.json with real requestIds) and 27 successful image/png renders in requests.jsonl

technical_claims.claim: Root size comes from layout constraints (SizedBox/Stack bounded 400x240), not from an HTML viewport
technical_claims.verified_by: every example PNG decodes to exactly (400, 240) and every page to (1200, 1600) with no viewport attribute anywhere in the DSL

technical_claims.claim: Row/Column distribute space in integer Expanded shares only inside bounded constraints (measured 1:2 split)
technical_claims.verified_by: probe render A17-probe-01 measured the Row split 1:2 exactly; example-02 visual check

technical_claims.claim: Stack+Positioned give one absolute coordinate system; clipBehavior=NONE lets children overhang without being clipped (Stack defaults to HARD_EDGE)
technical_claims.verified_by: example-02 red badge overhangs the card bottom edge and stays fully visible in the rendered PNG

technical_claims.claim: Plain text nodes are trimmed; Raw+CDATA preserves whitespace verbatim; a Raw outside a Text is a real 400 PARSE_ERROR
technical_claims.verified_by: probe render A17-probe-01 (CDATA vs trimmed) and the real error body smoke-03.png.error.json ('Raw ... can only be used in the Text')

technical_claims.claim: Nested <Text> children render as inline coloured spans; 8-digit colours are #RRGGBBAA (last two digits = alpha)
technical_claims.verified_by: example-03 renders 'A蓝B红CD' as three inline colours and #FF000080 over white measures (255,127,127)

technical_claims.claim: ImageFiltered blurs only its own subtree while BackdropFilter blurs what was painted behind it; sigma must be finite and >= 0, tileMode defaults to CLAMP
technical_claims.verified_by: experiments exp1-exp5 (A17-exp1..A17-exp5): ImageFiltered variant is pixel-identical to the no-filter control, backdrop variants differ only where the backdrop picture was painted

technical_claims.claim: Renderer detail behind the page-4 leak: BackdropFilterLayer.paint() re-draws LayerPaintContext.pictures.lastOrNull() - the most recently composited PictureLayer - through the image filter, and Recording only ends when a layer is pushed (pushLayer/pushOpacity/pushClip...)
technical_claims.verified_by: handbook-04 v1 render (A17-pg-04) blurred the whole preamble; paint-order change (A17-pg2-04) and Opacity isolation layer (A17-pg3-04) restored sharp text; final illustration band is pixel identical to example-04.png (0/18304 differing)

technical_claims.claim: A Container with a border attribute folds its colour into the border decoration; omitting colour yields a border-only outline (transparent fill)
technical_claims.verified_by: all four handbook pages render frame outlines after the core with the same 1px lines as before (pages 1-3 v1 vs v2 are pixel-identical)

technical_claims.claim: The service exposes 27 font families (Inter, Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans Mono CJK SC ...); mono Latin advance is 0.5em and CJK is 1.0em
technical_claims.verified_by: probe render A17-probe-01 measured 96 '0' glyphs = 958px ink at 20px (10px/char) and a 48-char CJK string wrapping 46+2 in a 1120px box
